sloka: तस्य चिन्तयमानस्य प्रत्यभात् कर्म दुष्कृतम् ।यद् अनेन कृतम् पूर्वम् अज्ञानात् शब्द वेधिना ॥२-६२-४॥
transliteration: tasya cintayamānasya pratyabhāt karma duṣkṛtam ।yad anena kṛtam pūrvam ajñānāt śabda vedhinā ॥2-62-4॥

translations.english: While he was thus reflecting on a sinful act he had inadvertently comitted long ago, the act of discharging an arrow that could hit its target following the sound, flashed in his mind.
translations.hindi: यह सुन सुमंत्र आँसू बहा, विकल हा और हाथ जोड़ कर, महारानी को धीरज बँधात हुए बाल
